item.title: A Terrifying Survival Take On Jurassic Park Is Coming to Steam Next Week
item.description: For some reason, there haven't been that many truly great dinosaur video games throughout history. Ark: Survival Evolved had plenty of success despite the fact it was quite janky, and The Isle has spawned myriad viral videos thanks to its proximity chat. Jurassic World Evolution 3 is by far the best licensed dinosaur game, but it focuses on managing the theme park, as opposed to fighting and surviving.

item.title: One of the GameCube’s Great Cult Classics Gets the Remaster It Deserves
item.description: When I was a kid, there were some games I only knew through magazines. I never played them, but they were all over the pages of Electronic Gaming Monthly and Nintendo Power, so I knew everything about them anyway. Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee was firmly a “magazine game” when it was released for the GameCube in 2002. I even had a free poster of it on my wall as a kid, one I kept hung up even after a wave of middling reviews eventually dropped.

item.title: Hideo Kojima's Next Game Officially Gets New Teaser Image, Fans Already Hunting for Clues
item.description: More than four years after its initial announcement, OD remains one of the biggest mysteries in the video game industry. We know Kojima Productions ’ next game is some sort of horror experience, and that genre auteur Jordan Peele contributed to the project, but specifics are hard to come by. Despite the caginess, we got a new look at OD as part of Kojima Productions’ 10th anniversary exhibition, which is running through Dec. 20 at Azabudai Hills Gallery in Tokyo.

item.title: FF7 Remake and Rebirth Are Less than $8 Each on Nintendo Switch 2
item.description: If you've been waiting for Final Fantasy 7 Remake and Rebirth to go on sale before checking them out, your patience has paid off. At least, as long as you're okay with a bit of DLSS hair-frizz . Square Enix is hosting a huge sale on the Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 eShop, and included in that sale are FF7 Remake and FF7 Rebirth for $7.99 and $7.49, respectively.

item.title: Huge Square Enix Sale for Switch 2 Includes 90+ Games At Discounts Up to 85% Off
item.description: Nintendo Switch 2 owners have plenty of great RPGs to choose from, but building up a digital library can get expensive. Fortunately, Square Enix is making that a little easier with a massive Nintendo eShop sale, offering steep discounts on some of its biggest franchises.

item.title: Percy Jackson Season 3 Official Trailer Shows Off Star-Studded New Cast
item.description: With just a few weeks until season 3 of Percy Jackson and the Olympians premieres, Disney has released a stunning new trailer for the next chapter of the Rick Riordan adaptation. Season 3, which will cover the 2007 novel The Titan's Curse , looks to be the darkest entry in the show yet. While the new trailer sets up the stakes of the latest adventure for Percy and friends, it also signals that the end of the road isn't far off.

item.title: Google Is Quietly Hiding A New Zelda: Ocarina of Time Easter Egg
item.description: The official release of the Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is only a couple of days away, but search engine Google has already started the festivities with a clever nod to Nintendo's landmark adventure game.

item.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Studio Officially Revealed
item.description: Nintendo is infamously cagey about revealing which studios are working on its games. While the company’s secrecy isn’t entirely out of step with an industry that generally hides how the sausage is made, Nintendo takes this to another level, trying to create a Disneyland-like sense of wonder around its brand.

item.title: FF14’s New Expansion Officially Addresses Dawntrail’s Biggest Problem
item.description: None of Final Fantasy 14 's expansions so far are overtly awful, but there are some that don't quite hit the highs of others. That was the case for 2024's Dawntrail expansion, which had the unenviable task of being the first part of the MMORPG's new arc. One major criticism from players fell on the story's pacing, which could admittedly be all over the place. For Evercold , the next expansion, Square Enix is making it a point to fix this.
